Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiasm for the Energy Marketing Coordinator position at Eastpak. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, combined with a deep passion for youth culture, fashion, and music, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to Eastpak's cultural relevance through collaborations and partnerships.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed skills in project management, stakeholder coordination, and integrated campaign execution. I have successfully managed on-page SEO, content strategy, and website development for clients, ensuring seamless delivery and measurable results. My experience building mirook.com, a project for a youth chess champion, demonstrates my ability to create compelling narratives and connect with niche audiences through culture-led storytelling.

I am particularly drawn to Eastpak's commitment to authenticity and community engagement. My international experience, working across cultures and languages, has equipped me with the cross-cultural communication skills essential for this role. I am eager to bring my proactive mindset, organizational prowess, and cultural insights to help drive Eastpak's collaborations and partnerships to new heights.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content creation, passionate about youth culture, fashion, and music. At Episto, I manage on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site builds, coordinating multiple projects and stakeholders. On my own project (mirook.com), I applied structured data and entity optimization to improve visibility across search engines, demonstrating my ability to create culture-led storytelling. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp, with international experience and cross-cultural communication skills. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- Brand Marketing & Partnerships: collaboration coordination, stakeholder management, integrated activation planning
- Content & Storytelling: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, culture-led narratives
- Project Management: coordinating multiple projects, timelines, and cross-functional teams
- Social Media & Influencer Marketing: content integration, social media coordination, trend monitoring
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization
- Web & Build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

## Experience

### Junior Digital Marketer — Episto (Remote), 2026–present
- Own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, improving organic visibility and search rankings
- Write keyword-targeted blog content for client websites to grow organic traffic
- Build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, including content uploads and page updates
- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions
- Coordinate with clients and internal teams to ensure project delivery and stakeholder satisfaction

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019
- Developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript)

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion: full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook)
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score

## Education
- Karel de Grote Hogeschool, Antwerp — Coursework in Applied Computer Science (2022–2025)
- Celal Bayar University, Türkiye — Coursework in Computer Science (2012–2016)
- Diyarbakır Anatolian High School, Türkiye — High School Diploma (2012)
